conflictAlert.title: Command Conflicts Detected
conflictAlert.description: There are {count} conflicting commands. Conflicting commands will trigger multiple plugins simultaneously, which may cause unexpected behavior.
conflictAlert.hint: Click the "Rename" button to rename conflicting commands and resolve conflicts.

permission.groupAdminHint: Everyone can use this command in private chats; only AstrBot administrators can use it in groups.
permission.followIsolationHint: Everyone can use this command in isolated group conversations and private chats; shared group conversations require AstrBot administrator permission.
permission.adminHint: Only AstrBot administrators can use this command in both private and group chats, regardless of conversation isolation.

filters.systemPluginConflictHint: System plugin conflicts detected. Resolve conflicts to hide.

sleep.globalMinutesLabel: Default idle minutes for new plugins
sleep.globalMinutesHint: Used only as the default idle threshold for newly installed plugins; 0 = resident by default, does not override individually configured plugins.
sleep.wakeHookAndCommand: Plugin commands, tools & filter handlers wake up
sleep.commandOnlyRisk: With plugin-commands-and-tools wake-up, the plugin process is terminated while asleep; it won't actively receive passive messages/events, and hooks won't wake it up
sleep.intro: Configure idle auto-sleep per plugin: when enabled, an idle plugin process is reclaimed after the configured minutes to free memory, and is lazily woken on next use (transparent). Resident (off) by default.
